named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.acctPath
named-native-query.query: SELECT ep_path FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = :parentId AND ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.insertAcctPath
named-native-query.query: INSERT INTO esq_entity_path (ep_pk, ep_et_pk, ep_path) VALUES (:pk, :kind, :path)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.insertAcct
named-native-query.query: INSERT INTO esq_account (acc_pk, acc_et_pk, acc_id, acc_desc, acc_ccy, acc_status, acct_neg_allowed_flg, acc_usr_pk, acc_crl_id, acc_req_id, acc_uid) VALUES (:id, :kind, :name, :desc, :ccy, :status, :negativeAllowed, :parentId, :correlationId, :requestId, :uid)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.pathFor
named-native-query.query: SELECT ep_path FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.updatePath
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_entity_path SET ep_path = :path, ep_change_no = ep_change_no + 1 WHERE ep_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.pathChangeNoFor
named-native-query.query: SELECT ep_change_no FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.entityChangeNoFor
named-native-query.query: SELECT COALESCE(o.org_change_no, u.usr_change_no, a.acc_change_no) FROM esq_entity_path ep LEFT JOIN esq_org o ON o.org_pk = ep.ep_pk LEFT JOIN esq_user u ON u.usr_pk = ep.ep_pk LEFT JOIN esq_account a ON a.acc_pk = ep.ep_pk WHERE ep.ep_pk = :id
